subject: Thank you for catching the calendar mix-up
text:
Hi,

I wanted to thank you for catching the mix-up with the workshop date before it became a bigger problem. I had read the calendar entry as a Thursday meeting, so I almost missed the room reservation confirmation. Your follow-up email was clear, and I appreciate the care you took in checking the organizer's notes. Your reminder reached the whole group at exactly the right moment. It saved the team unnecessary rework and prevented another round of rescheduling. I also noticed that you updated the shared schedule without making anyone feel responsible for the error. That kind of professionalism makes the next session much easier for everyone.

Thank you again for your patience and attention to detail.

Thanks,
